_comment: Copy thanh config.live.json va sua. Che do mac dinh dry_run: an toan, khong can key.
_daily_note: Dung MO VI THE MOI khi lo thuc te trong ngay (UTC) < -20% portfolio dau ngay. Vi the cu van duoc quan ly exit.
_exit_note: Exit ladder mirror y het paper (radar.py plan scalp): TP1 +50% ban 1/3, TP2 +100% ban them 1/3, con lai trailing -30% tu dinh; SL -25% cat het; smart exit khi >=2 vi tracked xa cung token/30p; time stop 480p (lai >=20% -> chot 1/2 giu 1/2 trailing, khong thi cat het).
_fee_buffer_note: Giu lai toi thieu 0.02 SOL trong vi cho phi tx + rent, khong dung de swap.
_impact_note: Bo qua lenh neu price impact vuot nguong (bao ve khoi coin kem thanh khoan).
_jupiter_note: Jupiter Swap API v1 (keyless). Neu co Jupiter API key rieng: doi thanh https://api.jup.ag (can them header x-api-key - tu sua code).
_key_note: File chua base58 secret key, chmod 600. KHONG commit, KHONG paste vao chat.
_mode_note: dry_run = chi log y dinh swap, KHONG gui transaction, khong can key. live = swap THAT bang tien that, bat buoc .solana_key ton tai va pubkey khop wallet_address (thieu -> tu dung).
_preflight_note: false = mo phong tx truoc khi gui (an toan hon, cham hon). true = gui thang (nhanh hon, rui ro hon).
_priority_note: Phi uu tien co dinh moi tx (20000 lamports = 0.00002 SOL). Hoac dang auto: {"auto": true, "max_lamports": 1000000, "level": "veryHigh"}.
_size_note: So USD moi lenh mua (paper dung tiers theo mcap; live test dung flat $10 cho don gian va an toan).
_slippage_note: 100 bps = 1%. Meme bien dong manh: 100-300 la hop ly. Cao hon = de bi front-run/sandwich.
